steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟分享連結（StudyLive 官方網域的短網址，沒有邀請碼）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the share link (a short link on StudyLive’s official domain; there is no code).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示使用網頁版，或從 App Store、Google Play 的官方上架頁安裝 App，再註冊或登入。
steps.en: Follow the page to use the web version, or install the app from its official App Store or Google Play listing, then register or log in.

steps.zh-TW: 鏡頭可以不開，麥克風預設靜音；站內可檢舉與封鎖其他使用者。
steps.en: The camera can stay off and the microphone is muted by default; users can report and block others in the app.

steps.zh-TW: App Store 年齡分級為 13+，隱私權政策提到會確認未滿 14 歲者的法定代理人同意。
steps.en: App Store rating is 13+, and the privacy policy mentions checking a legal guardian’s consent for users under 14.

intro.zh-TW: StudyLive 是 24 小時線上自習室；分享文案只有連結，沒有邀請碼或優惠。
intro.en: StudyLive, a 24-hour online study room: the share text has only a link, with no invite code or offer.

description.zh-TW:
StudyLive 是 24 小時線上自習室，由韓國的 StudyLive Co., Ltd. 營運，有網頁、iOS 與 Android 版本，可和其他人一起讀書。每天約可免費使用 1 小時，Premium 為付費訂閱。

本頁連結是分享功能產生的短網址，沒有邀請碼；分享文案與平台頁面都沒有說明邀請優惠，所以不列優惠。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
StudyLive is a 24-hour online study room run by StudyLive Co., Ltd. in South Korea, with web, iOS and Android versions. You study alongside other people. Free use is about 1 hour per day, and Premium is a paid subscription.

The link on this page is a short link from the app’s share function. It has no invite code, and neither the share text nor the platform’s pages describe an invite offer, so none is listed. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 分享文案只有 StudyLive 短網址，沒有邀請碼與優惠，網址原樣保留。link.studylive.co.kr 是營運公司網域 studylive.co.kr 的子網域，2026-10-24 維運者以瀏覽器開啟，會轉到 StudyLive 官網的繁體中文頁。邀請關係在註冊時是否被接受，沒有測試。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。營運公司在韓國；服務條款提供站內檢舉與封鎖功能。
notes.en: The share text has only the StudyLive short link, with no invite code or offer, and the address is kept exactly as shared. link.studylive.co.kr is a subdomain of the operator’s domain studylive.co.kr; opened in a browser by the maintainer on 2026-10-24, it redirected to the Traditional Chinese page of the official site. Whether a referral is accepted at sign-up was not tested. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing. The operator is in Korea, and the terms provide in-app reporting and blocking.

q.zh-TW: StudyLive 的分享連結需要邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need an invite code for the StudyLive share link?

a.zh-TW: 不需要。分享文案沒有邀請碼，StudyLive 的頁面也沒有說明邀請碼，請直接透過本頁連結開啟。
a.en: No. The share text has no code and StudyLive’s pages describe none, so open the link on this page directly.

q.zh-TW: 透過這條連結註冊有優惠嗎？
q.en: Is there an offer for signing up through this link?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有提到優惠，StudyLive 的頁面也沒有說明邀請優惠，所以不列優惠。每天約 1 小時的免費使用是一般限制，不是邀請優惠。
a.en: The share text mentions no offer and StudyLive’s pages describe no invite offer, so none is listed. The free use of about 1 hour per day is a general limit, not an invite offer.
